candidates.purpose: Deterministic market/order-book replay with inspectable execution paths and explicit data-fidelity boundaries
candidates.latencySuitability: MEDIUM for offline replay; not intended for TAGX live hot path
candidates.docsAndTests: Strong README and explicit fidelity model; pytest configured with branch coverage and 95% minimum coverage; Python/C++ equivalence is an explicit design requirement.
candidates.dependencies: Core has zero runtime dependencies; optional websockets/Databento/pyarrow and a pybind11 C++ extension.
candidates.securityNotes: Do not import compiled extension into production without sandbox build/SBOM review. Optional vendor connectors introduce credentials/network surfaces. Core replay itself is offline and inspectable.
candidates.lookAheadBiasRisk: LOW if TAGX preserves point-in-time event timestamps and immutable replay manifests. Risk rises if reconstructed data or final labels are fed back into ranking time.
candidates.dataQualityNotes: Excellent pattern: explicitly distinguishes observed MBO from reconstructed virtual MBO and does not present inferred queue state as observed truth.
candidates.reasonNotIntegrated: TAGX currently has bar/quote-level public data rather than true MBO/L2 evidence; adding the package now would increase complexity without improving early signal discovery. Borrow its replay/evidence semantics first.
